meta.note: The SWM token on other networks: the only official addresses, their pools and the bridge state. Pages /token and /get-swm and the home FAQ render from here (tools/build_pages.py checks that index.html carries every address). Add a network or a pool here, never in a page. The retired Solana mint is never listed.

supply.oracle: The total supply of each token follows what has been mined on SWARM mainnet, written to the token by an on-chain oracle; the part of that total that nobody holds sits in a reserve that cannot be spent. The figure to read on an explorer is the amount in circulation on that network, not the total.
supply.cap: The token contracts carry the same cap as the chain, 21 million, and mint only what the oracle reports as mined.
supply.circulatingDefinition: Circulating supply of SWARM, as this site states it: coins issued by the chain minus the balances of the three project funds (Core Development, Grants & Ecosystem, Community & Development Reserve). The project wallet that receives the block rewards of the closed start is reported as its own line and is not subtracted.
supply.circulatingNote: Owner item 307: default definition until the owner answers; the machine-readable supply file next to status.json is not built until then.

bridge.text: A bridge that moves SWM between SWARM mainnet and these networks is built and under review; it is not live. When it opens, this page will link its public reserves route, where anyone can check that the tokens in circulation on Base, BNB Smart Chain and Solana are matched by coins held on SWARM mainnet. Until then the project redeems nothing: a token on these networks cannot be exchanged for coins on SWARM mainnet through us.

marketMaker.status: PROPOSED, owner item 324 (wording not yet approved); requested by the Market Maker Operations session 2026-10-09
marketMaker.text: SWARM runs an automated trader that buys and sells SWM on the project's own pools so that the three pools stay in line with each other. It defends no level, promises nothing about what SWM is worth, and its limits and journal are published on request.
